scope: Two fixed-work Integer-set CPU cohorts, including the rejected nested-loop control. No gameplay FPS, isolated copy timing, Windows, other-machine or statistical noninferiority claim.
clock_scope: GCC process CPU clock; allocation, mutation, observation, cleanup, checks and folds all included; no overhead subtraction.
recipe_note: Absolute compiler/source/include paths were used in private execution. Template placeholders are explanatory, not a claim that these were literal argv. Old compiles without the shared kernel; other roles compile it.
schedule: Per cohort: three smoke8, three warmup128, then 18 measured128 targets in all six lexicographic variant orders; no dropped or retried targets.
selection_limit: The cursor control followed diagnosis and a rejected nested-loop control on this workload. These fixed six pairs are descriptive and not randomized independent trials or an FPS measurement.
